rationale: The redesign changes the paid product from open-ended supplier-data operations to a fixed-scope importer exposure decision workflow. It removes supplier cooperation, verifier accreditation, and registry control from the base delivery mechanism by using importer-provided shipment exports and permitting default-value analysis; actual-data collection and accredited verification become optional, prepaid external work. A proposed direct workflow-integration agreement makes access and the customer interface contractible without claiming present rights. The route remains development-stage because customer adoption, signed access, price, CAC, delivery load, margins, and renewal are unknown, while low-priced software, broker white-labelling, SAP bundling, and market narrowing remain material threats.

structural_change.control_instrument: Unsigned proposed nonexclusive workflow-integration and service agreement covering importer-provided shipment exports, exposure analysis, data handling, direct payment, and bounded support; no present right is claimed
structural_change.customer_relationship_owner: Unknown today; proposed direct contracts with in-scope EU importers
structural_change.dependency_change: Removes non-EU supplier cooperation and accredited verification as mandatory base-service dependencies; replaces them with contractible importer data access and customer adoption, while treating actual supplier data and verification as optional prepaid add-ons
structural_change.distribution_instrument: Founder-controlled targeted account outreach and proposed nonexclusive written referral agreements with accountants, customs advisers, and trade associations; no referral access is presently contracted
structural_change.fully_loaded_economic_effects: Fixed-scope diagnostics, capped monthly support, advance billing, and prepaid specialist or verifier work reduce labor variance and working-capital exposure versus open-ended supplier chasing. Target pricing is 6,000-15,000 PLN per diagnostic and 1,500-4,000 PLN monthly monitoring, but CAC, delivery hours, overhead, contribution margin, payback, and retention remain unvalidated and must be cohort-tested against low-priced substitutes.
structural_change.incumbent_response_defensibility: Brokers, CBAM software vendors, and SAP can bundle the core functions, so defensibility cannot rest on generic collection or filing. The proposed defense is integration-neutral quantified default-versus-actual decision value, direct importer service, and reusable lawful mappings; its effectiveness and data compounding are unproven.
